Context: 8. Reimbursement

- (f) Catering charges in respect of rail journey.If the Government servant has to compulsorily avail the catering facility and the cost is included in the rail fare for Rajdhani / Shatabdi / Duronto trains, the fare charged shall be reimbursable in full as per entitlement/ eligibility. - GID (13), Rule 13.
